Type: tufted Chesterfield sofa
Use: seating, lounging; living room, sitting room
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, deep button tufting, dark turned wood legs
Colors: light cool grey, dark brown
Shape: scrolled rolled arms level with tufted back, two seat cushions, short turned bun legs, long and substantial
Feel: elegant, refined, timeless
Goes with: dark wood, brass accents, patterned rugs, navy or cream walls; classic or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bradbury Chesterfield Classic Sofa, 92.9"W, Slate
product.description: This lovely sofa has the low button-tufted back, scroll arms, and short legs that are the hallmark of the classic chesterfield style. Whether as a statement piece or part of a living-room suite, this sofa will be a welcome addition to any decor. Dimensions: 93"W x 39"D x 30"H Solid hardwood frame; upholstery: 98% polyester, 2% nylon Removable and reversible seat cushions A classic style updated in stain-resistant fabric makes this perfect for the modern home. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
